author: Krono II
title: GNN Paradigm v2: Hybrid CNN-GNN Architecture
abstract: The first GNN test failed catastrophically, likely due to a lack of environmental context. This experiment tests a v2 hybrid architecture. A shallow CNN first encodes the grid into a feature map. The GNN then reasons over a graph of entities whose features are augmented with information sampled from this map. This test will determine if this hybrid approach can overcome the flaws of the pure GNN.
